title: Handshake decentralized DNS blockchain integration with cDNSd by Blink Labs

ms.promise:
・Develop primitives to handle Handshake block format
・Implement validation of Handshake proofs
・Demonstrate the ability to parse a Handshake block for specific domain ownership
ms.criteria:
All outputs. All code-related outputs must be completed and implemented according to any specifications in the corresponding GitHub issues (tickets).
All outputs. All code changes must be reviewed and approved by designated team members before being merged into the main branch.
All outputs. Any added unit tests which demonstrate outputs will be available in the codebase.
All outputs. Each GitHub issue associated with the milestone must be marked as "closed" or "done" upon completion of the related task.
ms.report:
Milestone 1: Complete
The parsing and validation of Handshake blockchain data has been implemented and demonstrated as specified in their corresponding tickets. A video demonstrating the evidence of the completion of this milestone is available on YouTube: https://youtu.be/f6lV1mcDRnM 
This is further evidenced by the code output, automated testing where applicable, and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 1 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/18, where Milestone 1 issues can be found and their specifications and code, linked pull requests within each issue, can be examined. All Milestone 1 tickets have been completed and closed. Corresponding usage documentation will be added as we progress and will be found here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/cdnsd.

ms.promise:
・Create the ability to store and retrieve Handshake blockchain data in cDNSd
・Create a Handshake resolver
・Create an ICANN resolver
・Implement a fallback from local (Cardano) to Handshake to ICANN resolvers
・Demonstrate DNS resolution for domains in local, Handshake, and ICANN

ms.report:
Milestone 3: Complete
Output: The ability to store and retrieve Handshake blockchain data has been created (1). The Handshake (2) and ICANN (3) resolvers have been created. The fallback from local (Cardano) to Handshake to ICANN resolvers have been implemented (4). A video has been included which demonstrates DNS resolution for domains in local, Handshake and ICANN (5 https://youtu.be/WEc3MFh7UGk).
Acceptance criteria and Evidence of completion can all be verified on GitHub as follows: This is evidenced by the code output, automated testing where applicable, and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 3 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/18, where Milestone 3 issues can be found and their specifications and code, linked pull requests within each issue, can be examined. All Milestone 3 tickets have been completed and closed. Documentation as we have progressed can be viewed here: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/blinklabs-io/cdnsd@v0.23.0/handshake
